findings.claim: In packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts, `apiDeletes.push(deletedEvent)` pushes the resolved value rather than a promise. The later `Promise.all(prismaPromises.concat(apiDeletes))` therefore does not wait for those deletions.

verifier.reason: In packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts:460-467, an unawaited `.forEach(async ...)` callback awaits `calendar?.deleteEvent(...)` on line 466 and pushes the resolved value `deletedEvent` into `apiDeletes` on line 467, so `await Promise.all(prismaPromises.concat(apiDeletes))` at packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts:652 does not wait for those deletions. This pre-existed in untouched code (the patch only added `await` to `getCalendar(credential)` at line 461).
